tei:div.tei:p: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who by His word brings on the evening, opens the gates in wisdom, changes the times with understanding, alters the periods and orders the stars in their watches in the sky according to His will. He creates day and night, causes light to give way to darkness and darkness to light, leads away the day and brings on the night and distinguishes between day and night. The Lord of Hosts is His Name. The living and eternal God will constantly reign over us for ever and ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who brings on evenings.
